notes: Month 1 only. Daily chat and travel, with two original TV-register scenes in Pack 4 on the same food-and-help themes. Difficulty moves one main lever per step: rate or reduction density, not both at once, and not a pile of new vocabulary.

packs.weekTheme: After a meal: splitting, treating, throwing in, card versus cash.
packs.weekThemeZh: 吃完饭以后：AA、请客、凑一份、刷卡还是现金。

difficultyCurve.note: Warm, clear daily talk. Light, common reductions (wanna, kinda, lemme, dunno). Introduce I got this / You sure? / throw in.
Same money language, a little faster. Recycle I got this and You sure?
Still two friends. didja appears on a familiar question.
Speed holds. Denser reductions (d'you, tell 'em, wanna just) and a human server.
Same reduction level, slightly faster. New chunk: I'll get you back.
The promised 'next one' lands. Recycle covered you / tell 'em / wanna just.
Top of the pack. Jordan joins, but the language is the same: split, throw in, I got the drinks. The third voice is not the difficulty lever; the rate is.

packs.weekTheme: Running late, rain, moving the meeting place, I'm on my way, soft apologies, and want to just do it tomorrow.
packs.weekThemeZh: 要晚到、下雨、改见面地点、我在路上了、软道歉、要不然明天再约。
signatureChunks: Can we push it a little?

difficultyCurve.note: Phone call, two people, soft apology plus a real time estimate.
Same call pattern, now actually on the road. I'm on my way / gimme like fifteen.
Weather forces a change. Recycle you wanna just.
Speed holds. Denser reductions: wanna meet somewhere, what're you gonna want, gimme like seven.
Signature soft cancel / move. Long function-word string: I don't want you to feel like you have to.
Role reversal: Maya is late. Recycle you're fine / I got a table.
Top of the pack. Jordan is discussed, not given a new speaking role, so the lever stays rate.

packs.weekTheme: Travel: rides, directions, hotel check-in, asking a stranger, a transit delay, changing a drop-off.
packs.weekThemeZh: 旅行出行：上车、问路、酒店入住、问陌生人、交通晚点、改下车点。

difficultyCurve.note: Rideshare pickup. Service talk that still sounds human.
Asking a stranger. Landmark directions, not guidebook English.
Hotel check-in. Recycle can I see / you're in…
Platform talk with a fellow passenger. Recycle how long / I guess we just wait.
Speed holds. drop me at the / here's fine actually / lemme out here.
Onboard ask. Recycle is this the right… / the next one.
Back at the hotel, early. Recycle reservation under, plus hold your bags.

packs.weekTheme: Travel food: ordering, a recommendation, a wrong order, allergies, a slow kitchen. Days 6–7 are original TV-register scenes on the same themes.
packs.weekThemeZh: 旅行中的吃：点餐、问推荐、上错菜、过敏、后厨太慢。第 6–7 场是同一主题上的原创剧场风对话。
signatureChunks: I think this is the wrong order
The kitchen's a little backed up

difficultyCurve.note: Ordering with a human server. I'll do… / can I get that without…
Asking for a real recommendation, not a tourist-script one.
Polite, clear correction. Recycle no onions from day 1.
Allergy language that has to stay precise. New items kept to allergic / check.
Speed holds. Recycle How long are we talking? from Pack 2. Denser wanna / gonna / text 'em.
TV-register on the waiting/sharing theme: overlap, dry humor, yeah no. Still original, no show plot.
TV-register on the wrong-order theme, slightly messier attitude. Recycle I'll fix that / let me take care of that.
